revisions.title: Revisions noted
revisions.footnote: Markups are annotations, not measurements — quantities above are unaffected.

materials.title: Supporting materials — buy list
materials.formula: Each quantity = measured {area / linear / count} ÷ your coverage rate, rounded up to whole units.

footnote.waste: {{AU}} w/Waste = measured quantity × waste %. Waste is set per condition in the canvas. Wall {{AU}} comes from Surface-Area traces (run × height); Border {{AU}} from Linear runs with a thickness.
footnote.waste_metric: Supporting-material coverage rates stay as entered ({{au}}/{{lu}}-based).
footnote.perimeter: Perim {{LU}} (ref) sums floor-trace perimeters — includes door openings and shared walls; reference only, never totaled or waste-adjusted.
footnote.base: Base quantities as measured per sheet — waste not applied.
footnote.reconcile: — sheet subtotals × multiplier reconcile to the condition table.
footnote.sheet_groups: Groups show w/Waste quantities (waste and ×N applied per sheet); the By-sheet section below shows base measured quantities.

contribute.title: Contribute to the open flooring model
contribute.description: Help grow a shared, flooring-tuned open model. We send only the
contribute.li1: condition labels, shape types, and quantities (SF / LF / EA)
contribute.li2: normalized room geometry (shape only — no scale, no location)
contribute.li3: how each shape was made (hand-traced vs. machine-proposed) and whether you corrected it
contribute.never_sent: Never sent: the PDF itself, file names, project or client names, your markups, or any absolute coordinates.
contribute.no_endpoint: This build has no contribution endpoint configured, so nothing can be sent. (Set VITE_CONTRIBUTE_ENDPOINT at build time, or localStorage.opentakeoff_contribute_endpoint in your browser.)
contribute.attest: I have the right to share this takeoff data and am contributing it to the open flooring model.
contribute.thanks: Thank you — your takeoff is now helping train the open flooring model.

drive.up_to_date: Already up to date — no new templates.
